Our story

Stride started in a small running club – and we still test every shoe on our Sunday runs.

Five friends from a Southwark running club opened Stride in 2018. We wanted one shop that sold the sport and street wear we actually run, train and live in.

Every product still has to survive ten kilometres in the rain before it makes it into the shop.

Founded

2018, London

Run club members

1,200

Products tested a year

300

Every Sunday at 9 am from our store on Riverside Walk – 5 or 10 km, all paces, coffee afterwards. Free for everyone.
